objective_value: <float> Total travel distance summed over all arcs traversed by all vehicles.
num_vehicles_used: <int> Number of vehicles that leave the depot to visit at least one customer.

routes.vehicle: <int> Identifier of the vehicle assigned to this route.
routes.route: <list[int], length varies> Ordered sequence of node identifiers visited, starting at the departure depot (0) and ending at the return depot (num_customers+1).
routes.deliveries: <dict, key: '{customer_id}'> Quantity of goods this vehicle delivers to each customer it visits on this route.

<customer_id>.demand: <int> Original demand quantity of the customer.
<customer_id>.total_delivered: <float> Total quantity delivered to the customer summed across all vehicles that visit it.
